title: AP SLPRB Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 2,050 Constable, SI, Driver and Other Posts
description: Andhra Pradesh State Level Police Recruitment Board (AP SLPRB) has introduced the Latest Job Notification for the posts of 2,050 Constables, Sub-Inspectors, Drivers, Scientific Assistant, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have completed their 10th Pass, Any Degree, B.E/ B.Tech, Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering,  12th, ITI, or M.Sc. can use this chance and apply for the AP SLPRB Notification 2026 . Here, we have included more details about the age limit, selection process...
